oracle.executed_scope: visual and text FP32 PyTorch references; desktop and Android ONNX CPU

image.orientation: apply EXIF orientation including mirrors exactly once

same_rgb_arithmetic_checks.scope: same already resized RGB bytes; arithmetic only, not a full image processor run

tokenizer.application_text_boundary: source str.strip(); preserve case; no extra NFC/NFKC, ftfy, HTML unescape or translation
tokenizer.android_implementation: pure Kotlin cased WordPiece v1; user selected option 1

text.variant_decision: single published U8U8 INT8 artifact; user selected option 1

embedding.normalization: L2 once at application boundary; core Embedding already provides it

identity.revision_recipe: SHA-256 of manifest without revision field; UTF-8, sorted keys, compact separators, ensure_ascii=false

tolerances.status: engineering acceptance budgets fixed before neural measurements

validation.image_validation_scope: single controlled opaque RGB PNG; API 35 x86_64 emulator CPU

query_encoder.session_lifetime: one explicitly owned session per adapter; user final option 1
query_encoder.close: blocking and idempotent; invoke off main; waits for current call
query_encoder.cancellation: cooperative checks; cancelled result discarded; active native call is not forcibly terminated
